decls.rationale: Step 3 of Proposition 3.8, property (P2): a descending chain of open normal subgroups of \(\overline{G}\) with indices \(\to \infty\) yields fields \(F_j\) with \(F_j/F\) finite Galois, everywhere unramified, 3-group Galois group, and \(f_j \to \infty\).
